description:
About me: CS student at Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute. Specializing in Machine Learning, Python (Pandas, LightGBM, ETL), and C# .NET Backend. I have experience applying ML to physical processes and building solid backend architectures.

What we are building: A working interactive simulator. We will train an ML model on NASA's combustion data and use SHAP to explain the physical factors driving fire risks in space, wrapped in a clean UI.
